I’m a unique blend of Mechanical Engineering (MSc Aerospace) and Law (LLB). I bridge the gap between heavy technical systems and legal frameworks, using Data Science as my primary tool for analysis and innovation.

- Data Science: Uncovering insights from complex datasets to solve cross-disciplinary problems.
